My story

How one curiosity turned into three crafts.

  1. Chapter 01 — The first pixel

    It started with graphics

    Posters, logos and social media designs taught me layout, colour and type — and how a single image can make someone stop and look.

  2. Chapter 02 — Levelling up

    Then came UI/UX

    I moved from single images to whole experiences: how people move through an app, where they hesitate, and how design quietly guides them.

  3. Chapter 03 — Making it real

    Then I learned to build it

    Web development closed the loop. Now the interfaces I design don’t stop at a mockup — I code them into fast, working websites myself.

  4. Today

    All three, one roof

    As an independent freelancer I take projects from first sketch to final launch — no hand-offs, no lost details, one person who owns the whole result.
